words.gloss: even by a slip of tongue

literal: To those who possess good conduct, it is impossible indeed, evil words, even by a slip of tongue, by mouth, to speak.
translation: For those who possess good conduct, it is impossible to speak evil words, even by a slip of the tongue.
modern: ஒழுக்கம் உடையவர்களுக்கு, தவறியும் கூடத் தங்கள் வாயால் தீமையான சொற்களைச் சொல்லுதல் இயலாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights how deeply good conduct is ingrained in a virtuous person. For those who possess propriety and discipline, uttering harmful or evil words is completely unnatural. Even by an accidental slip of the tongue, they will not let bad words escape their mouth. The word 'ollāvē' emphasizes that such speech is entirely incompatible with their character, showing that true conduct governs even one's involuntary utterances.
